question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessions.diagnose` and `openclaw sessions diagnose` as a durable public operator diagnosis contract with the proposed outcome and finding-code vocabulary?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-tested, but only maintainers can decide whether this Gateway/CLI/protocol surface is the product contract OpenClaw should support.

options.title: Accept the read-only contract
options.body: Merge after ordinary maintainer review and keep the proposed stable diagnosis vocabulary as the supported operator surface.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to trim or rename outcomes, findings, or CLI text until maintainers are comfortable with the public support commitment.

options.title: Defer the surface
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause or close this PR if maintainers want diagnosis folded into a broader session-recovery design instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the read-only contract
recommendation.body: Merge after ordinary maintainer review and keep the proposed stable diagnosis vocabulary as the supported operator surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history signal across the affected Gateway, protocol, and diagnostic-session files.
